verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a SaaS AI code-review service like cubic, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection, or where data is stored. The cited items cover reviews, analytics, APIs, CLI and MCP, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
